title: Solve GJ
tagline: Retired 2026-09-26: this feature recomputed the torsional stiffness GJ of an EI and Cross Section feature. EI and Cross Section now computes GJ itself.

slides.title: What it does
slides.problem: GJ used to be a separate step. EI and Cross Section now computes GJ itself (step 3b, a Reissner-Mindlin width reduction, xSect_GJ.fs), and the Solve GJ tab, GJ_Feature.fs, gjAnalysis.fs and gjDataAccess.fs were deleted on 2026-09-26.
useWhen: An older document still has it in the tree
slides.caption: GJ (orange) is already in every EI and Cross Section result.

slides.title: The dialog
params: One EI and Cross Section feature.
slides.note: Historical: the old formula was GJ = 4 x sum(G x Iz) over the section's triangles (G = Q66). The current solver is a 1D Reissner-Mindlin reduction across the width (400 bins).

keys: GJ of every station in the feature's CrossSectionAnalysis data and table.
